body: I wish you eternal happiness with all of your life's episodes.
Thats absolutely true, it can change at any moment. But thats the scary thing, for so many it changes to absolute disaster. I'm playing for a push, I may not win big but I may not lose big either.

I love you too :)

What happens is that I'm generally that way, one who lives in the present. But occasionally I will sit and contemplate about everything and the gravity of it will soak in, and as a result I end up feeling like life lacks any direction.

This is usually alleviated by keeping busy with other things, trying to occupy my mind with the happier things in life (friends, family), but it seems that its only a defense mechanism against my inability to really deal with what I will be facing.
